generation.scope: All singular boundary Hankel members of integral eight-cofactor matrices are excluded even on nonreduced finite Frobenius windows. The residual by the conductor line extends scheme-theoretically to the pole-free eigenvector surface and has length at most sixteen. The conductor cut itself has length at most three.

open_mathematics: Analyze singular finite pencil members on nonreduced windows through the binary quintic skew identity, the common cubic incidence, proportional pairs and constant scalar components. Higher-cofactor, reducible determinants and general windows remain open.
